structural_selections.causal_limit: opens device-local hazard or report opportunities but selects no failure, report, receipt, investigation, response, or diagnosis
route eligibility never implies issue, transport, receipt, acknowledgement, interpretation, or action
unit assembly cannot create shared observations, private state, authority, policy, or results
identity or title never supplies availability, route delivery, or authority outside the effective capacity
defines adjudication dimensions for product, production, inventory, remedy, custody, and handling without selecting a result
warning, recall, order, or message proposal, issue, publication, effect, delivery, implementation, enforcement, and response remain distinct

variant_materialization.inactive_population_actor_rule: declared assignments and route endpoints remain referentially valid but are ineligible for issue, delivery, observation, or action
